summaryOfChange: Restructured the branch order so `view.status === 'OPERATIVE_STATE_RESOLVED'` is checked FIRST and dominates, before `view.currentText` presence is ever consulted. Previously the function checked `view.currentText !== null` first and returned evidenceCurrent: true unconditionally inside that branch, relying on an unenforced comment claim that non-null currentText implied RESOLVED status. Added one new ResolvedNodeEvidence.textSource literal ('UNRESOLVED_AMENDED_TEXT') so a real-but-unresolved amendment's proposed text is never labeled identically to a genuinely resolved replacement (AMENDED_CURRENT_TEXT). Exported the function (previously module-private) so it can be tested directly, per this phase's own requirement.
linesChanged: lines ~216-334 (header comment through function body) in the pre-patch file; net +40/-30 lines (see git diff)

"HISTORICAL_BASE_TEXT" : "BASE_DOCUMENT_TEXT", ..., evidenceCurrent: false, unresolvedReasons }; } ... CASE D ...
afterCode: if (view) { const currentTextPresent = view.currentText !== null && view.currentText !== undefined; if (view.status !== "OPERATIVE_STATE_RESOLVED") { /* CASE A */ const text = currentTextPresent ? view.currentText! : raw; return { text, textSource: currentTextPresent ? "UNRESOLVED_AMENDED_TEXT" : "BASE_DOCUMENT_TEXT", ..., evidenceCurrent: false, unresolvedReasons }; } if (currentTextPresent) { /* CASE B */ return { text: view.currentText!, textSource: "AMENDED_CURRENT_TEXT", ..., evidenceCurrent: true, unresolvedReasons: [] }; } /* CASE C */ return { text: raw, textSource: "HISTORICAL_BASE_TEXT", ..., evidenceCurrent: false, unresolvedReasons }; } /* CASE D unchanged */

typeChange: ResolvedNodeEvidence.textSource widened from 3 to 4 literals: 'AMENDED_CURRENT_TEXT' | 'UNRESOLVED_AMENDED_TEXT' (NEW) | 'BASE_DOCUMENT_TEXT' | 'HISTORICAL_BASE_TEXT'. Confirmed non-breaking: no consumer in the repository switches on textSource (grep -rn textSource across lib/ and tests/ confirms only the interface declaration, this function's own returns, and descriptive doc-comments reference it).
exportChange: resolveNodeWithSupersessionAwareness changed from a module-private `function` to `export function` - no behavior change, confirmed via tsc/eslint/full regression.
callersUnchanged: getParentClause, getSiblingClauses, getReferencedProvision (absolute + fromNodeId paths) - all 4 call sites in tools.ts are byte-identical before/after this patch; only the shared helper's own internal logic changed.

testsUpdatedToReflectFix: tests/certification/open2-terminal-independent-recert-fresh2.test.ts - 3 assertions that previously documented the STILL_OPEN bug (section 4's FINDING test, section 10's cross-tool FINDING test, section 10's END TO END REAL POSTGRES FINDING test) were updated to assert the CLOSED/fixed behavior instead, since this phase's fix directly closes the exact gap those tests were recording. Comments were rewritten from 'STILL_OPEN'/'FINDING' framing to 'FIXED'/'UPDATE' framing, preserving the historical narrative rather than deleting it.
